# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

**DISCLAIMER**: The study is currently undergoing peer-review. Therefore, the code base is under active development. It includes code for all data presented in the manuscript but also exploratory data analysis parts. File paths have to be adjusted by the user. 

# Software requirements

```{r}
#Data containers
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(SingleCellExperiment)

#Data processing

library(scater)
library(scran)
library(imcRtools)

#Data visualization
library(cytomapper)
library(dittoSeq)
library(pheatmap)
library(cowplot)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

#Utilities
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)
library(parallel)
library(BiocParallel)
library(BiocNeighbors)
library(BiocSingular)
library(tiff)
library(ggrepel)
library(EBImage)

library(mclust)
library(Rphenograph)
library(igraph)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)

library(psych)

library(psych)
```



# Load Data: images, masks and sce
```{r}
images <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/images.rds")
masks <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/masks.rds") # masks_cp6 (used for final segmentation)
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_02.rds")
# sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_02_counts.rds") # sce with counts assay

# load patient metadata
patient_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC.csv",col_names = TRUE)
patient_meta$TMA_id <- str_replace(paste0(patient_meta$grid,"x",patient_meta$x,"y",patient_meta$y),"NA","")
patient_meta$TMA_id <- str_replace(patient_meta$TMA_id, "x","X")
patient_meta$TMA_id <- str_replace(patient_meta$TMA_id, "y","Y")
patient_meta[is.na(patient_meta$x),]$TMA_id <- "CX7Y8" #was missing in data


```

# Prepare sce

```{r}
#Load TMA tissue masks

sce$tissue_area <- as.numeric(tissue_area$AreaShape_Area[match(colData(sce)$sample_id,str_split(tissue_area$FileName_Tissue_Mask, "_Pro",simplify = TRUE)[,1])])
```

## Add info on pixel artifact 

```{r}
library(readxl)
pixel_removal <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/summary_pixel_removal.xlsx")

# Add logical entry to colData of sce
sce$pixel_artifacts_corrected <- sce$sample_id %in% pixel_removal$Column1
```

## Filter for tumor cells 

```{r}
# Type 
type_df <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(PID, type) %>% unique() %>% group_by(type) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

# change NA to "unknown"
colData(sce)$type[is.na(colData(sce)$type)] <- "unknown"

# update Type DF
type_df <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% unique() %>% group_by(type) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

ggplot(type_df, aes(x = reorder(type,-n), y = n, fill = type))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  theme_classic()+
  # scale_fill_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$type)+
  ylab("Number of patients")+
  xlab("Type")

# overlook of subtypes
colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(PID, type, subtype) %>% unique() %>% group_by(type, subtype) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))
```



# Cell-level QC

Look at cells which are (1) too small, (2) too little nuclear expression and (3) too big and if necessary delete them.
Only cells from (2) are deleted.

## Add total nuclear expression per cell

```{r}
assay_matrix <- assay(sce, "exprs")[c("H3", "Ir191", "Ir193"), ]
nuc_exprs <- colSums(assay_matrix) %>% unname

colData(sce)$nuc_exprs <- nuc_exprs

## Add cell_id
sce$cell_id <- colnames(sce)
```


### (1) Small cells

No cells are deleted.

```{r}
# smallest cells: area = 15

# look at area size
hist(sce$area, breaks=50)
abline(v = quantile(sce$area, 0.001), col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)  # 0.001 quantile 

quantile(sce$area, 0.001) # 16


# images with cells <16 to check threshold. Check only images with a lot of <16 cells.
img_small_cells <- colData(sce)%>% as.data.frame()%>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, area)%>%
  filter(area<16)%>%
  group_by(sample_id)%>%
  summarise(count=n())%>%
  arrange(desc(count))%>%
  head(30)%>%
  pull(sample_id)

# label cells (small or not small)  n cells = 785	
small_cells <- colData(sce) %>%
  as.data.frame()%>%
  dplyr::select(area, nuc_exprs, cell_id)%>%
  filter(area<16)%>%
  pull(cell_id)

colData(sce)$small_cells <- case_when(
  colData(sce)$cell_id %in% small_cells ~ 1,
  .default = 2
)


# visualize image

# Normalize and clip images
cur_images_small_cells <- images[names(images) %in% img_small_cells]
cur_images_small_cells <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images_small_cells, separateImages = TRUE)
cur_images_small_cells <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images_small_cells, inputRange = c(0, 0.2))


plotPixels(cur_images_small_cells, 
           object = sce,
           mask = masks[names(masks) %in% img_small_cells],
           cell_id = "ObjectNumber",
           img_id = "sample_id",
           missing_colour = "white",
           colour_by = c("Ir193","Ir191", "H3", "CD8a", "CD68", "CD45RO"),
           colour = list("Ir193" = c("black","cyan"),
                         "Ir191" = c("black", "cyan"),
                         "H3" = c("black", "cyan"),
                         "CD8a" = c("black", "red"), # look at immune cells
                         "CD68" = c("black", "red"),
                         "CD45RO" = c("black", "orange")
                         ),
           image_title = list(cex = 0.8),
           outline_by = "small_cells",
           image_title = list(cex = 0.8),
           legend = list(colour_by.title.cex = 0.7,
                         colour_by.labels.cex = 0.7),
           save_plot = list(filename = paste0("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/03_QC/small_cells_threshold_16.png")))

# cells are meaningful and thus are not deleted
```



### (2) Non-expressing cells

Cells with a nuc_threshold > 1 are deleted.

*cellpose generated some cells without nuclear expresison*

```{r}
# set nuc_exprs threshold to 1
threshold <- 1

## Histogram
sce_data <- data.frame(nuc_exprs = sce$nuc_exprs)
ggplot(sce_data, aes(x = nuc_exprs)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), binwidth = 0.2, fill = "#CADCFC", color = "#00246B") +
  geom_density(colour = "#00246B")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = threshold, color = "#CC313D", linetype = "solid", size = 1.2) +
  theme_classic()+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(sce$nuc_exprs), max(sce$nuc_exprs), by = 1))

## quantile percentage
quantile_percentage <- ecdf(sce$nuc_exprs)(1)

# extract images with a lot of cells nuc_exprs <= 1 
img_low_exprs_cells <- colData(sce)%>% as.data.frame()%>%
  filter(nuc_exprs<=threshold)%>%
  group_by(sample_id)%>%
  summarise(count=n())%>%
  arrange(desc(count))%>%
  head(30)%>%
  pull(sample_id)

# label cells with low nuc_expr
cell_low <- colData(sce) %>%  as.data.frame()%>%
  filter(nuc_exprs<=threshold)%>%
  pull(cell_id)

colData(sce)$cell_low<- case_when(
  colData(sce)$cell_id %in% cell_low ~ 1,
  .default = 2
)
```

### (3) Big cells

No cells are deleted. 

```{r}
# look at area size
hist(sce$area)
abline(v = quantile(sce$area, 0.01), col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)  # 0.01 quantile 
abline(v = quantile(sce$area, 0.999), col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)  # 0.01 quantile 

quantile(sce$area, 0.999) # 342 => too small, maybe check cells that are big and have little expression. Some cancer cells are very big with a lot of expression!

# images with cells >=342 to check threshold. Check only images with a lot of these cells.
img_big_cells <- colData(sce)%>% as.data.frame()%>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, area, nuc_exprs)%>%
  filter(area>=342 & nuc_exprs>0.58)%>% # only big expressing cells
  group_by(sample_id)%>%
  summarise(count=n())%>%
  arrange(desc(count))%>%
  head(30)%>%
  pull(sample_id)

# label cells # n = 23
big_cells <- colData(sce) %>%
  as.data.frame()%>%
  dplyr::select(area, nuc_exprs, cell_id)%>%
  filter(area>=750 & nuc_exprs>0.58)%>%
  pull(cell_id)

colData(sce)$big_cells <- case_when(
  colData(sce)$cell_id %in% big_cells ~ 1,
  .default = 2
)

# visualize image

# Normalize and clip images
cur_images_big_cells <- images[names(images) %in% img_big_cells]
cur_images_big_cells <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images_big_cells, separateImages = TRUE)
cur_images_big_cells <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images_big_cells, inputRange = c(0, 0.2))


plotPixels(cur_images_big_cells, 
           object = sce,
           mask = masks[names(masks) %in% img_big_cells],
           cell_id = "ObjectNumber",
           img_id = "sample_id",
           missing_colour = "white",
           colour_by = c("Ir193","Ir191", "H3"),
           colour = list("Ir193" = c("black","cyan"),
                         "Ir191" = c("black", "cyan"),
                         "H3" = c("black", "cyan")),
           image_title = list(cex = 0.8),
           outline_by = "big_cells",
           image_title = list(cex = 0.8),
           legend = list(colour_by.title.cex = 0.7,
                         colour_by.labels.cex = 0.7),
           save_plot = list(filename = paste0("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/03_QC/big_cells_threshold.png")))

# big cells are kept.
```

# Image-level QC

Find and delete abnormal images

## Mean marker expression per image

```{r}
library(scuttle)

sce$TMA_fine <- paste0(str_split(sce$sample_id, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1],"_", str_split(sce$sample_id, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,2])


image_mean <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, 
                                   ids = sce$sample_id, 
                                   statistics="mean",
                                   use.assay.type = "exprs")

# clustered (cluster_cols = TRUE overwrites order.by)
dittoHeatmap(image_mean, genes = rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$use_channel],
             assay = "exprs", cluster_cols = TRUE, scale = "none",
             heatmap.colors = viridis(100), 
             annot.by = c("PID", "TMA_fine","subtype"),
             annotation_colors = list(PID = metadata(sce)$colors$PID,
                                      subtype = metadata(sce)$colors$subtype
                                      ),
             show_colnames = FALSE)

# a lot of markers are very low abundant


# ordered by TMA_fine
dittoHeatmap(image_mean, genes =
              rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$use_channel],
             assay = "exprs", cluster_cols = FALSE, scale = "none",
             heatmap.colors = viridis(100), 
             annot.by = c("PID", "TMA_fine","subtype"),
             order.by = "TMA_fine",
             annotation_colors = list(PID = metadata(sce)$colors$PID,
                                      subtype = metadata(sce)$colors$subtype
                                      ),
             show_colnames = FALSE)
# Block 3 shows overall higher expression. The rest of the TMAs look similar.
# all patients overall similar expressions, ZTMA224.1 Block2 maybe patients with very low expressions

# ordered by subtype
dittoHeatmap(image_mean, genes = rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$use_channel],
             assay = "exprs", cluster_cols = FALSE, scale = "none",
             heatmap.colors = viridis(100), 
             annot.by = c("PID", "TMA_fine","subtype"),
             order.by = "subtype",
             annotation_colors = list(PID = metadata(sce)$colors$PID,
                                      subtype = metadata(sce)$colors$subtype
                                      ),
             show_colnames = FALSE)
# as expected, ccRCC dominated by CA9 whereas papillary RCC dominated by pan CK.
# higher CD68 observed in pappillary RCC
# low overall expression in chromophobe RCC
# CD7 and CD274 colocalize 


# look at high abundant subtypes separately
all_subtypes <- unique(colData(sce)$subtype)
high_subtypes <- all_subtypes[all_subtypes %in% c("clear_cell_RCC", "papillary_RCC", "chromophobe_RCC")]

dittoHeatmap(image_mean[, image_mean$subtype %in% high_subtypes], 
             genes = rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$use_channel],
             assay = "exprs", cluster_cols = FALSE, scale = "none",
             heatmap.colors = viridis(100), 
             annot.by = c("PID", "TMA_fine","subtype"),
             order.by = "subtype",
             annotation_colors = list(PID = metadata(sce)$colors$PID,
                                      subtype = metadata(sce)$colors$subtype
                                      ),
             show_colnames = FALSE)

# look at low abundant subtypes separately
low_subtypes <- all_subtypes[!(all_subtypes %in% c("clear_cell_RCC", "papillary_RCC", "chromophobe_RCC"))]

dittoHeatmap(image_mean[, image_mean$subtype %in% low_subtypes], 
             genes = rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$use_channel],
             assay = "exprs", cluster_cols = FALSE, scale = "none",
             heatmap.colors = viridis(100), 
             annot.by = c("PID", "TMA_fine","subtype"),
             order.by = "subtype",
             annotation_colors = list(PID = metadata(sce)$colors$PID,
                                      subtype = metadata(sce)$colors$subtype
                                      ),
             show_colnames = FALSE)
```

###Focusing on ccRCC
```{r}
# ccRCC
sce$TMA_fine <- paste0(str_split(sce$sample_id, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1],"_", str_split(sce$sample_id, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,2])


image_mean <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, 
                                   ids = sce$sample_id, 
                                   statistics="mean",
                                   use.assay.type = "exprs")

## only numeric values allowed for annotation
image_mean$gender_binary <- ifelse(image_mean$gender == "f", 1, 0)
image_mean$survival_data_binary <- ifelse(image_mean$survival_data == "TRUE", 1, 0)
image_mean$WES_data_binary <- ifelse(image_mean$WES_data == "TRUE", 1, 0)
image_mean$tar_sequencing_data_binary <- ifelse(image_mean$tar_sequencing_data == "TRUE", 1, 0)
image_mean$pT_simple_noNA <- ifelse(is.na(image_mean$pT_simple), 5, image_mean$pT_simple)
image_mean$ISUP_noNA <- ifelse(is.na(image_mean$ISUP), 5, image_mean$ISUP)
image_mean$necrose_noNA <- ifelse(is.na(image_mean$necrose), 3, image_mean$necrose)

## update color vectors
new_col <- metadata(image_mean)$colors$pT_simple
names(new_col)[length(new_col)] <- "5"
metadata(image_mean)$colors$pT_simple <- new_col

new_col <- metadata(image_mean)$colors$ISUP
names(new_col)[length(new_col)] <- "5"
metadata(image_mean)$colors$ISUP <- new_col

new_col <- metadata(image_mean)$colors$necrose
names(new_col)[length(new_col)] <- "3"
metadata(image_mean)$colors$necrose <- new_col

## Subset to markers of interest
MOI_channel <- c("MPO", "SMA", "panCK", "GATA3", "GATA3", "4-1BB", "CD68",  "CD45RA",  "CD20","CD3","LAG-3", "CD279", "CD7", "GranB", "CD274", "EOMES", "CD45RO", "FOXP3", "CD278", "CXCL13", "CD8a", "GITR", "CA9", "CD134", "CD4", "Tbet", "CD31/vWF", "Tim-3", "NKG2A", "GranK", "Vim", "CD11c")
rowData(image_mean)$MOI_channel <- rowData(image_mean)$clean_target%in%MOI_channel

## plot
h_mean_expr <- dittoHeatmap(image_mean[,image_mean$subtype == "clear_cell_RCC"], genes = rownames(image_mean)[rowData(image_mean)$MOI_channel],
             assay = "exprs", cluster_cols = TRUE, scale = "none",
             heatmap.colors = viridis(100), 
             annot.by = c("PID", "TMA_fine", "gender_binary", "age_bin", "pT_simple_noNA", "ISUP_noNA", "necrose_noNA", "survival_data_binary", "WES_data_binary", "tar_sequencing_data_binary"),
```

```{r}
tot_exprs <- colSums(assay(image_mean))
colData(image_mean)$tot_exprs <- tot_exprs


# look at images with very low and very high total marker expression
hist(tot_exprs)
abline(v = quantile(tot_exprs, 0.01), col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)  # 0.01 quantile 
abline(v = quantile(tot_exprs, 0.99), col = "blue", lwd = 2, lty = 2)  # 0.99 quantile

# 1% quantile
quantile(tot_exprs, 0.01) # 7.297506 lower threshold
quantile(tot_exprs, 0.99) # 25.62905 upper threshold

colData(image_mean)%>%
  as.data.frame()%>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, tot_exprs)%>%
  filter(tot_exprs<=7.297506| tot_exprs>=25.62905)%>%
  arrange(desc(tot_exprs))

# save images for visualization
images_high_exprs <- colData(image_mean)%>%
  as.data.frame()%>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, tot_exprs)%>%
  filter(tot_exprs>=25.62905)%>%
  arrange(desc(tot_exprs))%>%
  pull(sample_id)

images_low_exprs <- colData(image_mean)%>%
  as.data.frame()%>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, tot_exprs)%>%
  filter(tot_exprs<=7.297506 )%>%
  arrange(desc(tot_exprs))%>%
  pull(sample_id)
```

## Subtype

Number of patients
```{r}
# Re-group subtypes 
sce$subtype_combined <- ifelse(sce$subtype %in% c("clear_cell_RCC", "papillary_RCC", "chromophobe_RCC"), sce$subtype, "other")
sce$subtype_combined[sce$subtype_combined == "clear_cell_RCC"] <- "ccRCC"
sce$subtype_combined[sce$subtype_combined == "papillary_RCC"] <- "pRCC"
sce$subtype_combined[sce$subtype_combined == "chromophobe_RCC"] <- "chrRCC"

metadata(sce)$colors$subtype_combined <- setNames(c("#63A8A0", "#A6CEE3","#C3AAD2","grey"),c("ccRCC","chrRCC","pRCC","other"))  

# Subtype  combined
subtype_df <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(PID, subtype_combined) %>% unique() %>% group_by(subtype_combined) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

ggplot(subtype_df, aes(x = reorder(subtype_combined,-n), y = n, fill = subtype_combined))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_fill_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$subtype_combined)+
  ylab("Number of patients")+
  xlab("Subtype")

# all subtypes
subtype_df <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(PID, subtype) %>% unique() %>% group_by(subtype) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

ggplot(subtype_df, aes(x = reorder(subtype,-n), y = n, fill = subtype))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size=5)+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("Number of patients")+
  xlab("Subtype")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1))

# all subtypes with n >= 5
subtype_df <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(PID, subtype) %>% unique() %>% group_by(subtype) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% filter(n >= 5)

ggplot(subtype_df, aes(x = reorder(subtype,-n), y = n, fill = subtype))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size=5)+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("Number of patients")+
  xlab("Subtype")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1))
```

### Test overlap of clinical categories

```{r}
PID_scores <- list()

PID_scores[[1]] <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% filter(ISUP_combined == "3/4" & subtype_combined == "ccRCC") %>% dplyr::select(PID) %>% unique() %>% pull(PID)

PID_scores[[2]] <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% filter(pT_combined == "3/4" & subtype_combined == "ccRCC") %>% dplyr::select(PID) %>% unique() %>% pull(PID)

PID_scores[[3]] <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% filter(necrose == "1" & subtype_combined == "ccRCC") %>% dplyr::select(PID) %>% unique() %>% pull(PID)

names(PID_scores) <- c("ISUP (3/4)","pT (3/4)","necrose (1)")

library("ggVennDiagram")
ggVennDiagram(PID_scores,
              label_alpha = 0, 
              set_color = "black")+
  scale_fill_gradient2(high = "gray50")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black","black","black"))

```

### Survival of CC 

```{r}
sce$status_OS <- ifelse(sce$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 1, 0, 
       ifelse(sce$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 0, 1, sce$censor_dead_0_alive_1))

sce$OS_months <- sce$survival_months

sce$pT_combined <- ifelse(sce$pT_simple %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(sce$pT_simple %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", sce$pT_simple))
# sce$`pT12/34` <- NULL 

sce$ISUP_combined <- ifelse(sce$ISUP %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(sce$ISUP %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", sce$ISUP))
sce$lymphocytes_combined <- ifelse(sce$lymphocytes %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", sce$lymphocytes)
```

```{r}
## Assess survival impact of clinical categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

cur_surv <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% filter(subtype_combined %in% c("ccRCC")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(PID, pT_simple, pT_combined, ISUP, ISUP_combined, lymphocytes, lymphocytes_combined, necrose, OS_months, status_OS) %>% unique()


# Tumor stages
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ pT_simple, data = cur_surv)
print(fit)

ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = c("grey", "#ABCFE5", "#3787C0", "#08306B"),
          conf.int = TRUE
          #log.rank.weights = "n"
)


fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ pT_combined, data = cur_surv)
print(fit)

p2 <- ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = c("#ABCFE5", "#08306B"),
          conf.int = TRUE)


# ISUP grading

print(fit_1)

ggsurvplot(fit_1,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(),
          conf.int = TRUE,
          palette = c("grey", "#FC9F81", "#E32F27", "#67000D")
          #log.rank.weights = "n"
)


fit_1 <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ISUP_combined, data = cur_surv)
print(fit_1)

p1 <- ggsurvplot(fit_1,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table

          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups

# Necrosis
fit_3 <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ necrose, data = cur_surv)
print(fit_3)

p3 <- ggsurvplot(fit_3,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(),
          conf.int = TRUE, # Change ggplot2 theme
          palette = c("grey", "#3F007D")
          #log.rank.weights = "n"
)
```

# Dimensionality reduction


## ccRCC - all markers 

```{r}
sce_ccRCC <- sce[,sce$subtype_combined == "ccRCC"]

## Subsample 10% of cells from each core
#to save time and not get super crowded dimensionality reduction plots
set.seed(24)
sub <- colData(sce_ccRCC) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by("sample_id") %>% slice_sample(prop = 0.1) %>% arrange("sample_id") %>% mutate(sub_id = paste(sample_id,ObjectNumber,sep="_")) %>% pull(sub_id)
sce_sub <- sce_ccRCC[,sub]


rowData(sce_sub)%>% as.data.frame()%>%
  dplyr::select(use_channel, clean_target)


#Run UMAP/TSNE
set.seed(2024)
sce_sub <- runUMAP(sce_sub[rowData(sce_sub)$use_channel,], n_neighbors = 50, pca = 50,exprs_values = "exprs", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())

sce_sub <- runTSNE(sce_sub[rowData(sce_sub)$use_channel,], exprs_values = "exprs", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam())
```

### visualise TSNE

```{r}
## 1. Visualize TSNE - "exprs
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD45RO")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "SMA")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CA9")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "panCK")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD8a")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD68")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD7")+
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "CD8a")

sce_sub$TMA <- as.character(sce_sub$TMA)
plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", colour_by = "TMA")

# Visualize all marker expression
all_plots_TSNE <- lapply(c(rownames(sce_sub)[rowData(sce_sub)$use_channel]),
                    function(x){
                      p <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", 
                                          colour_by = x, 
                                          by_exprs_values = "exprs",
                                          point_size = 0.5)+
                        guides(color = "none")+
                        ggtitle(paste0(x))
                      return(p)                    
                    })
all_plots_TSNE

library(patchwork)

# Combine all plots into a single plot
combined_plot <- all_plots_TSNE[[1]]
for (i in 2:length(all_plots_TSNE)) {
  combined_plot <- combined_plot + all_plots_TSNE[[i]]
}

# Save the combined plot
ggsave("combined_TSNE_plots.png", plot = combined_plot, path = "/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/03_QC/", width = 12, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```
